title: Distributed Saga compensation workflow on failure

workspace.test_saga.py:
from saga import Saga
import pytest

def test_saga():
    s = Saga()
    comp = []
    s.add_step(lambda: None, lambda: comp.append('s1'))
    def fail(): raise RuntimeError('err')
    s.add_step(fail, lambda: comp.append('s2'))
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        s.execute()
    assert comp == ['s1']
